big_case.notes: Execution-eve capital stay application on a fact-bound Wiggins mitigation claim that the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals dismissed under art. 11.071 sec. 5. The individual stakes are the highest there are, but the application drew no amicus, no called-for response and no noted dissent, and the unexplained denial sets no rule beyond this prisoner.

leakage.notes: Forward cell; the default applies. Checked rather than assumed: seven calls, all captured. The only dated retrieval is a corpus query (retrieved_doc_date 2026-11-17, a different case's same-week denial) and a docket-number lookup of the linked petition that the candidate reports as showing no distribution and no disposition. No CourtListener call, no web search, no live-docket fetch, no read of data/qp-topics. reasoning.md says outright that the candidate did not check the live docket and does not know whether the Court had already acted.
